words.gloss: those things praised by the wise

literal: Those things praised, guarding and doing is required; without doing, to those who neglected, even in seven births there is none.
translation: One must cherish and perform those actions praised by the wise; for those who neglect them and fail to perform them, there is no redemption even in seven births.
modern: சான்றோரால் புகழப்பட்ட செயல்களைப் போற்றிச் செய்ய வேண்டும்; அவற்றைச் செய்யாமல் அலட்சியம் செய்தவர்க்கு ஏழு பிறவிகளிலும் நன்மை உண்டாகாது.
explanation: This couplet highlights the severe consequences of negligence or forgetfulness in performing one's duties. The poet advises that we must carefully guard and perform those noble deeds that have been praised (புகழ்ந்தவை) by wise elders. If a person neglects (செய்யாது இகழ்ந்தார்க்கு) these duties out of laziness or carelessness, they will suffer the consequences. The phrase 'எழுமையும் இல்' warns that such negligent individuals will find no happiness or elevation in any of their seven successive births.
